scale_note: collective = rigid-body physics of a simultaneous release (r5); population and behaviour layers belong to ff-eco

runs.title: v3b VLM non-convergence diagnosis: collocation-placement defect, corrected lattice, camber effect
runs.does_not_establish: No fin load, flight or biological claim: an inviscid thin-surface lattice-convergence diagnosis of three designed fin geometries; no body, viscosity or separation.

runs.title: Wing area / AR / placement sweep for launch glide range with printed-mass and constraint checks
runs.does_not_establish: No achieved range: point-mass glide with fixed CL and assumed polars; ranges are +-20% at best and nothing was printed or thrown; hand-launch feasibility is not shown.

runs.title: Underwater rigid-body drag build-up: fish3d variants and printed glider, fins spread vs folded
runs.does_not_establish: No measured or CFD-resolved drag at the target Reynolds number; no swimming, wave drag or surface taxiing; rigid deep-water build-up only.

runs.title: Aeroelastic deflection over the sourced fin-ray stiffness range (two-way static VLM+beam)
runs.does_not_establish: No flying-fish fin stiffness: the sourced EI is bluegill rays (Alben 2007); torsion-rigid, linear beam; does not establish fin twist, membrane mechanics or in-flight deformation.

runs.title: Staggered collective release of printed gliders (PyBullet 6-DOF, wake coupling, contacts)
runs.does_not_establish: No observed schooling or launch: rigid printed gliders released with assumed timing offsets and dispersion; no sensing, control or behaviour (ff-eco); straight horseshoe wakes, no wake roll-up or decay.

runs.title: R2 wing designs re-flown in 6-DOF with moment-balance trim (CG and pelvic key) and launch dispersion
runs.does_not_establish: No flight test: 6-DOF quasi-steady glider with assumed polars, CLmax and dispersion; trims are computed, not hand-trimmed; keys above dec+4 do not exist as prints; no aeroelasticity (R4) or launch-stroke loads.

runs.title: Fin torsion added to the two-way static aeroelastic loop (VLM + bending + twist)
runs.does_not_establish: No measured fin torsional stiffness: GJ is swept as a ratio of EI (biology unsourced) and estimated for the print with an ASSUMED Poisson ratio; uniform rod about an assumed elastic axis; no membrane, ray network or unsteady loads.

runs.title: v3b design-change test: rebuilt fins with altered camber/sweep, corrected-collocation VLM
runs.does_not_establish: No measured fin pose or lift: inviscid thin-surface VLM on rebuilt designed geometry; camber sign and sweep are assumed deployment knobs (Park & Choi 2010 unread); no body, viscosity or separation.

runs.title: Integrated collective launch: R6-recommended designs with the R5b staggered release (PyBullet 6-DOF)
runs.does_not_establish: No observed launch or schooling: rigid printed gliders of computed (not hand-trimmed) designs released under an assumed timing rule and dispersion; straight horseshoe wakes; no control or behaviour (ff-eco).

runs.title: 6-DOF flights of R6 designs with an R4b quasi-static aeroelastic correction to pectoral lift
runs.does_not_establish: No measured fin flexibility or flight: a quasi-static lift multiplier from R4b (v3a fin geometry, assumed elastic axis and Poisson ratio) applied in the 6-DOF model; no fin dynamics or flutter.

runs.title: Collective launch of printed gliders in PyBullet (6-DOF, quasi-steady per-surface aero, contacts)
runs.does_not_establish: No observed schooling or collective behaviour: rigid printed gliders released together under an ASSUMED dispersion; no sensing, control, decision or population dynamics (ff-eco owns those); wake model is a straight horseshoe per fish.
